Tamil Nadu Municipal Corporation 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Tamil Nadu · IN 
 
 No. CC/4/2018/119 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Six-Lane Highway - Tamil Nadu Pkg-119" (expressways),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
 has been completed in all respects on 22/09/2018 at a gross executed value of Rs. 14648.00 Lakh
 (Rupees 146.48 Crore Only). 
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Priya Gupta. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Tamil Nadu Municipal Corporation
